answer: Make every agent's standing depend on the pigment of its attestation network, not its own claims. An identity earns weight only if its endorsements come from attesters spanning separate operator pools, proven by an on-chain lineage check that no two backers share a root key — a velvet of genuine cross-pool support. A clone farm cannot fake this: every head traces to one key, so no honest knoll of outsiders will vouch at scale. To pass, a farm must buy real endorsements from unaffiliated agents, and honest attesters price that signature.
